# Japan Alert Decoder

> Free, keyless decoder for Japanese emergency alerts: what an alert means, its alert level, what to do now (by situation) and its official name in 14 languages. Covers 緊急地震速報 Earthquake Early Warning (warning / forecast / cancellation), shindo, tsunami (大津波警報 / 津波警報 / 津波注意報), the new level-named weather warnings in force since 2026-05-29 (Level 5 特別警報 Emergency Warning, Level 4 危険警報 Urgent Warning, Level 3 警報 Warning, Level 2 注意報 Advisory for 大雨 heavy rain, 土砂災害 landslide, 氾濫 flood, 高潮 storm surge; Level 1 早期注意情報) and the old names they replaced, other weather warnings, 気象防災速報 (線状降水帯), municipal evacuation levels (緊急安全確保 / 避難指示 / 高齢者等避難), Nankai Trough Earthquake Extra Information, the Hokkaido-Sanriku Subsequent Earthquake Advisory, volcanic alert levels, J-ALERT missile alerts and heat-stroke alerts. Data as of 2026-10-17. Educational guide, not an alert service: no live data; always follow official instructions.

Site: https://japan-alert-decoder.vercel.app

## Key facts (official sources below)
- Since 2026-05-29 (JMA "new disaster weather information") warnings carry the level in their name: e.g. 土砂災害警戒情報 → レベル4土砂災害危険警報 "Level 4 Urgent Warning (Landslide)"; 大雨警報（土砂災害） → レベル3土砂災害警報; 大雨警報（浸水害） → レベル3大雨警報; 洪水警報 / 洪水注意報 are no longer issued (merged into 大雨, plus 氾濫 for named rivers); 氾濫発生情報 → レベル5氾濫特別警報; 氾濫危険情報 → レベル4氾濫危険警報; old 高潮警報 (Level 4) → レベル4高潮危険警報, while レベル3高潮警報 is now Level 3.
- Colours: Level 5 black, 4 purple, 3 red, 2 yellow, 1 white. Evacuate by Level 4. Municipal info: L5 緊急安全確保 Emergency Safety Measures, L4 避難指示 Evacuation Instruction, L3 高齢者等避難 Evacuation of the Elderly, etc.
- 気象防災速報 replaced 記録的短時間大雨情報, 顕著な大雨に関する気象情報 (now 線状降水帯発生), 竜巻注意情報 and 顕著な大雪に関する気象情報; new 線状降水帯直前予測.
- EEW warning: 2+ stations, predicted max intensity 5-lower+ (or long-period class 3+); names areas expecting 4+. Act: protect your head, take cover, don't rush outside; train: hold the strap; driving: hazard lights, slow down gradually, stop on the left; elevator: stop at the nearest floor.
- 2026-10-16 12:40 JST: a false EEW (warning) for Hokkaido-Chubu (estimated M9.9 near the Kuril Islands) was cancelled; JMA said its 700 km station-exclusion filter had failed, fixed it about 21:30 and apologised. 「先ほど発表した緊急地震速報を取り消します」 = "JMA has cancelled the EEW."
- Tsunami: 大津波警報 >3 m (5 m / 10 m / >10 m / 巨大), 津波警報 1-3 m (3 m / 高い): evacuate immediately to high ground; 津波注意報 0.2-1 m: leave the water and coast.
- Nankai Trough Extra Information: 調査中 (5-30 min after M6.8+), then 巨大地震警戒 (one week of pre-evacuation for some coastal residents), 巨大地震注意 (no pre-evacuation; re-check preparedness) or 調査終了.
- J-ALERT missile: go into a sturdy building or underground; if none, take cover or lie flat protecting your head; indoors, away from windows.

## API (free, no key, CORS open)

### GET
GET https://japan-alert-decoder.vercel.app/api/decode?text=緊急地震速報 強い揺れに備えてください&situation=train
→ verdict "decoded", urgency "act_now", primary {id "eew-warning", nameJa, nameEn, meaning, doNow (train first: hold the strap), dont, howLong, note, sources}

GET https://japan-alert-decoder.vercel.app/api/decode?text=土砂災害警戒情報&lang=vi
→ primary l4-landslide "Level 4 Urgent Warning (Landslide)", nameLocal (Vietnamese, from the JMA dictionary), color purple, renamed [old name note]

GET https://japan-alert-decoder.vercel.app/api/decode?alert=tsunami-advisory&situation=coast&lang=ko

Params: text (alert text, Japanese or English, up to 4,000 chars); alert (id from /api/rules, e.g. eew-warning, eew-cancel, major-tsunami-warning, l4-landslide, l5-heavy-rain, evac-l4, bulletin-linear-rainband, nankai-megaquake-advisory, missile, heat-alert, volcano-l3); situation (indoors, outdoors, driving, train, elevator, crowd, coast, mountain); lang (ja, en, zh-CN, zh-TW, ko, pt, es, id, vi, tl, th, ne, km, my, mn). Returns verdict, headline, urgency, primary, also, modifiers {cancelled, lifted, drill}, extracted {level, shindo, tsunamiHeight}, renamed, notes, checkLive (official live maps), dataAsOf, sources. /api/check is an alias.

### POST
POST https://japan-alert-decoder.vercel.app/api/decode
Content-Type: application/json
```json
{"text": "【警戒レベル4】避難指示 発令", "situation": "indoors", "lang": "zh-CN"}
```

### All alert types, old→new names, shindo and tsunami tables, sources
GET https://japan-alert-decoder.vercel.app/api/rules

## Disclaimer
Educational guide, not an alert service and not official: no live data. Always follow official instructions (JMA, your municipality, police, fire, staff). In an emergency, protect yourself first. Not affiliated with JMA or any government agency.
